rows.50:52b8:

{f:I|I} couldn't say a word.{p}{f:And so|...Well then}, at last, it was down to the final one{f:.|.}{p}

rows.50:58a0:

{f:We|We} stood rooted to the spot, as if frozen.{p}
rows.50:5c1c: The next instant, Arai sank his teeth into Kazama's stomach.{p}

rows.50:5fec:

{f:I|I} stepped in between them.{p}
rows.50:60f8:

rows.50:61a0: Kazama's anger, which had started to die down, seemed to flare up all over again.{p}

rows.50:6828:

rows.50:6904:

rows.50:695c:

rows.50:6a08:

rows.50:6ac0: With that, he put his hand on the doorknob.{p}
rows.50:6af8:
Suddenly, Kazama's scream thundered through the room.
{f:A black shadow had crept|It looked as if a black shadow had crept} from the doorknob up into Kazama's hand.{p}
rows.50:6d10: When Arai held up his hand, the black shadow around Kazama's hand vanished, as if melting into the air.{p}

{f:I|I} looked around at everyone.

{f:I|I} kept asking myself.

{f:I|I} wavered.
"There's no time left."

{f:I|I} stared at the floor, thinking.
{f:Maybe|Maybe} {f:I|I} really should be the one to be sacrificed...
{f:I|I} made up my mind.
...I would be the sacrifice.

rows.50:7124: When I followed their gaze, I found it was fixed on Kazama.{p}
rows.50:7164:

"{f:What do you think, huh?|I'm not going to say we should sacrifice you, see.}

rows.50:7408:
{f:I|I} didn't say a word.

rows.50:74a0:
"Hey, Arai, {c}{f: will do| can go and fetch Hino now}{f: for that sacrifice you mentioned earlier, right?|, I'm thinking.}"
"{f:I don't mind.|So you're going to sacrifice him?}
{f:Is that all right with everyone|In that case, there's no need to call him}{f:?|. I'll send the spirit to wherever he is.}"

rows.50:7684: Just then, there was a violent noise outside the room.{p}
rows.50:76c8:

I'm going home now."

rows.50:79b4: He opened the door and slowly stepped out of the room.{p}
rows.50:79e4:

Along with Kazama's scream, the pale blue light gradually grew weaker.{p}

Arai murmured, and left the room.{p}
rows.50:7b00:

He {f:seemed to come to|slowly opened his eyes}.

rows.50:7db0:

rows.50:7f1c: According to Hino, {f:Kazama has mellowed since then and doesn't say ridiculous things anymore.|Kazama mellowed after that and stopped saying ridiculous things.}{p}

Preserving the scene is the duty of every good citizen, and when it's something as serious as a murder, all the more so...

{f:I|I} decided to take the legs.
The arms {f:went to|would be held by} Kazama and one other person.

We came out into the dark, deserted hallway.
Afraid we'd be seen, I couldn't help glancing around.
Arai is small, so why is he this heavy?
I remembered a story about some foreign occult researcher who put a gravely ill patient on a big scale to measure the weight of the soul.

My hands slipped with sweat.

Sweat was running down my forehead too, but I couldn't even wipe it away.{p}
rows.50:9120:
Still, we somehow made it to the stairs.
Once we got down these stairs, I'd have someone take over.
That's what {f:I|I} thought.

Lit by the dim light, {f:our|our} shadows writhed across the wall.

Just as I was thinking that...{p}
rows.50:924c:
Behind me, there was a horrible scream.
What happened★{p}
rows.50:9290:
At the same moment, something heavy fell onto my back.
I nearly missed a step and desperately braced myself.{p}
rows.50:92fc:
Then, onto {f:my|my} shoulder, a slightly lighter impact.
What on earth is going on★{p}

Kazama and the others must have nearly tripped on the stairs.
So they had let go of the arms.
That's why Arai's upper body had fallen against {f:my|my} back.
Because of it, {f:I|I} had nearly fallen too.
Even without that, the thought of carrying a corpse on my back made me sick.
"Come on, that's awful..."
Just as {f:I|I} was about to complain...{p}
rows.50:9570:
Arai's eyes flew open and looked at {f:me|me}!
Blood trickled slowly from the corner of his mouth!

{f:I|I} lost my balance and pitched out into the dark void.{p}

Was Arai not dead after all★
Had he come back to life out of sheer rage★

rows.50:9774:
{f:I|I} decided to take an arm.
Kazama would take the other arm.

rows.50:993c:
